'''2023 US Nationals Bill Kafer DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2023 U.S. National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Bill Kafer]]
* '''Event:''' [[2023 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
